notes.title: HotFix No.3 Volume adjustment, full screen bugfix, correction of some anomalies
notes.notes:
・The volume was increased and adjusted overall.
・Fixed a problem that full screen was automatically canceled when returning to the title.
・Fixed some anomalies.
・Reset function for clearing anomaly status was implemented.

notes.title: HotFix No.2 Achievement
notes.notes:
Fixed Achievement could not be unlocked in most cases.
If Achievement is unlockable already, it will be unlocked at startup.

notes.title: HotFix No.1
notes.notes: Fixed a problem in which restarting the game when the remaining anomaly was 0 would cause the UI to display incorrectly and the ending could not be reached.
